content.short: Biconomy Core helps apps ship smart accounts, sponsored gas, and smoother onchain flows across EVM networks.
content.description: Biconomy Core is account abstraction infrastructure for developers building easier onchain experiences. Its stack includes smart accounts, paymasters, bundlers, and SDKs that support gas sponsorship, batched actions, and programmable wallet flows. The platform also offers routing for gasless swaps and crosschain execution, helping teams reduce setup work while keeping custody with the user. Mantle projects can use Biconomy to remove native gas friction, simplify onboarding, and design cleaner transaction journeys inside their apps.
content.meta: Biconomy Core provides smart account and gas abstraction infrastructure for Mantle apps.
